readings.meaning: law, legal matter, court, or lawyer
comparison, pros and cons, or trade-offs

weigh options or pros and cons
compare two alternatives side by side
update a will or estate plan
calibrate or buy a precision scale

reasoning: A classic two-pan balance scale universally recognized as the symbol of law, courts, legal matters, and weighing options or trade-offs. It fits tasks involving lawyers, legal disputes, jury duty, estate planning, compliance, and side-by-side comparisons, while body-weight tasks are better served by a bathroom scale icon.
